findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use.

The hand sink next to the three part sink was observed with a cart in front of it, blocking access and use. The PIC was shown and removed the cart to correct. Ensure that all hand sinks are maintained accessible at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

There is a crack in the seal along the top junction of the roof/wall in the walk in cooler. The PIC was shown and instructed to re-seal prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that all areas subject to moisture remain sealed and with a smooth and easily cleanable surface.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.citation_text:
6-403.11(A) Designated Areas. (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use TOBACCO PRODUCTS shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination.

A pair of employee beverages (sodas) are observed in a box in the walk in cooler that also contains sliced deli meats. This box is on the top shelf of the wire shelving racks. The situation was discussed with the PIC and the drinks removed to correct. Ensure that employee drinks/foods are stored below and/or away from foods intended for consumers. A cooler in the front of the area is observed with other drinks in it and would be a far better location for storing these items moving forward.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. 

On arrival the hand sink as you enter the deli/bakery prep areas is without paper towels. The PIC was notified and called maintenance for immediate replacement. Ensure that all hand sinks are properly supplied at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. 

The covers on the fans in the walk in freezer are observed with dust residue in excess. The PIC was shown and instructed to have cleaned. These should be maintained clean at all times moving forward.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

The hand sink next to the three part sink as well as the one next to the fryers are observed with carts in front of them. The PIC was consulted and the cart moved during the inspection to correct. Ensure that all hand sinks are maintained easily accessible at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria.

Two spray bottles are observed in the food prep areas that are intended for sanitizing food contact surfaces. One bottle has ran out of solution. The other would not register on inspector or facility test strips. Simple troubleshooting was conducted and an inconsistent amount of solution is observed coming out of the dispenser. It is possible that the bag of concentrate is leaking. The bag was replaced during this inspection and the solution brought into acceptable concentration ranges to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.12: (A) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking and baking EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours. This section does not apply to hot oil cooking and filtering EQUIPMENT if it is cleaned as specified in Subparagraph 4-602.11(D)(6). 

The racks in the chicken baking oven are heavily coated with baked on char. This is a food contact items and should be cleaned regularly to prevent this accumulation. The PICs were shown this and instructed to clean the equipment, and maintain it free of accumulated food debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. 

A thick accumulation of ice is observed along the floor/wall junction at the far right of the walk in freezer under the shelves. Remove the ice and maintain the floor both clean and easily cleanable.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria.

The spray bottle of sanitizer in the foods preparation/handling area does not register on either the inspector’s or the facility’s test strips.The bottle was remade during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.  

Containers of pasta, chicken and rice are observed with internal temperatures ranging from 45F-48F at the north end of the island cooler. Items appear to be stacked to high in the cooler and were discarded during this inspection by the person in charge (PIC). Ensure TCS foods are stored so that they remain within safe temperature ranges.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment:
The PERSON IN CHARGE shall: (A) FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations not conducted in private home/room with sleeping quarters;  (B) restricted access ; (C) visitors comply with Code; (D) monitor EMPLOYEES' handwashing; (E) monitor deliveries;  (F) approved source/unadulterated;  (G) proper cooking TCS Food; (H) proper cooling ; (I) monitoring temperatures; (J) consumer advisory conveyed; (K) proper sanitizing;  (L) buffets are controlled;  (M) preventing cross-contamination of RTE FOOD with bare hands; (N) EMPLOYEES are properly trained in FOOD; (O) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of responsibility to report information about health; (P) Written procedures and plans are maintained and implemented as required. Pf  

The pizza cooler next to the entry doors does not appear to be holding effective temperature at this time. The thermometer for the unit shows approximately 50F and pizzas along the bottom left of the unit are observed at temperature ranges between 46F and 50F. Follow up for the cooler to be conducted in two weeks.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. 

1) Multiple TCS foods in the island cooler are observed with internal temperatures ranging from 45F to 51F. These items appear to be out of temperature at this time due to blocked air vents in the cooler. Education conducted with the PIC and it is suggested that foods in these coolers are not stored directly contacting the air vents and  also stored so that proper airflow can take place in the unit. Affected foods were discarded during this inspection and include sub sandwiches, hamburgers and calzones. 
2) Multiple pizzas in the bottom left of the pizza cooler are observed out of temperature at this time. Pizzas discarded during this inspection to correct. Line item #1 includes the follow up for this cooler’s function.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment:
The PERSON IN CHARGE shall: (A) FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations not conducted in private home/room with sleeping quarters;  (B) restricted access ; (C) visitors comply with Code; (D) monitor EMPLOYEES' handwashing; (E) monitor deliveries;  (F) approved source/unadulterated;  (G) proper cooking TCS Food; (H) proper cooling ; (I) monitoring temperatures; (J) consumer advisory conveyed; (K) proper sanitizing;  (L) buffets are controlled;  (M) preventing cross-contamination of RTE FOOD with bare hands; (N) EMPLOYEES are properly trained in FOOD; (O) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of responsibility to report information about health; (P) Written procedures and plans are maintained and implemented as required. Pf  

The coolers noted on violations #22 were not able to be fixed at the time of this inspection. Follow up for these coolers functioning correctly will be conducted in 2 weeks.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

The hand sink next to the three part sink is observed with a cart in front of it. The cart had multiple boxes and appeared to be waiting for the boxes to be broken down for discard. PIC consulted and the cart moved during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. 

1) Items in the island cooler in front of the deli are probed with internal temperatures between 43F to 48F. Items appear to be on the outside edges of the unit and primarily at the ends. Items include multiple packages of sub sandwiches, diagonally cut sandwiches, calzones, and Philly calzones. Items out of temperature were discarded during this inspection to correct. Refer to line item #2 for cooler follow ups. 

2) The bottom shelf of the pizza cooler as you enter the facility is observed with internal temperatures of 46F. Pizzas were discarded to correct. Refer to line item #2 for cooler follow ups.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

(REPEAT) 1) Ice accumulation observed in the walk-in freezer. Repair machine and remove ice accumulation. Remove frequently enough to prevent accumulation.

2) Floor corner is soiled in the walk in cooler with a milky off white colored substance. Clean often enough to prevent accumulation.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Employee observed to apply soap to hands then quickly rinse hands off and return to food prep activities. CORRECTED- Discussed with PIC, who will provide education to staff. Ensure hands are washed with soap and running water for 20 seconds.
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. [P]

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: No sanitizer observed prepared during inspection. CORRECTED- Sanitizer solution prepared. Sanitizer must be prepared prior to beginning any food prep/handling.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11 (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Ice accumulation observed in the walk-in freezer. Repair machine and remove ice accumulation. Remove frequently enough to prevent accumulation.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Chicken lo mein and chicken alfredo observed in the deli area island cooler at 45 to 55F. Food were stacked four to five high. Bottom two containers were observed 41F or below. CORRECTED— Out of temperature foods voluntarily discarded. Reviewed proper stocking procedures.
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. [P]

findings.title: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures & records
findings.comment:
Foods in the hot case (various preparations of chicken, mashed potatoes, gravy, mac & cheese, etc) are not marked with any time indicating the time they were removed from temperature control or the time they need to be used or discarded by. CORRECTED— Discussed with PIC. Time markings added to foods (prepared at 9AM).
3-501.19: (B) If time is used as control for up to 4 hours, food shall have initial temperature of 41F (or less) or 135F (or greater). FOOD shall be marked, cooked and served within 4 hour time limit. If FOOD is unmarked or marked exceeding 4-hour limit, FOOD shall be discarded. [P]

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: No sanitizer prepared in the deli area. CORRECTED— Discussed with PIC, who made a sanitizer spray bottle. Sanitizer must be prepared before food prep/handling begins.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11 (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. [C]

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures
findings.comment: Popcorn shrimp in the customer hot cart was 116°F (probed). CORRECTED- Out of temperature foods were discarded. Other foods in this hot holding unit were observed to be above 135°F.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16 TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained: (1) At 57°C (135°F) or above. (P)

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment: In the deli island, prepackaged sushi was 50°F (probed) and a prepackaged hardboiled egg was 45°F (probed). CORRECTED- Out of temperature foods were discarded. Other foods in this cold holding unit were observed to be above 41°F. PIC determined that the unit had been in a defrost mode. Foods probed shortly after these temperatures were taken were found to be 41°F or below.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16 TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained (2) At 5ºC (41ºF) or less. (P)

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed cart blocking handsink near cook line. CORRECTED- PIC moved the cart so that handsink is easily accessible.
5-205.11 (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (Pf)

Observed front handsink with paper towel dispenser jammed. CORRECTED- Maintenance was called to ensure paper towels are provided.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with (A) Individual, disposable towels; (Pf)

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment: Observed employee cellphone on counter near cook line. CORRECTED- Cellphone was relocated to acceptable location.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.110 (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used for the orderly storage of EMPLOYEE clothing and other possessions. (C)

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.citation_text:
750.530 - Deli manager was chewing gum upon arrival of inspector. Gum was discarded at the request of inspector. Associates should not be eating/drinking in food prep and service areas, this includes eating candy and chewing gum.

Employees shall consume food only in designated dining areas. An employee dining area shall not be so designated if consuming food there may result in contamination of other food, equipment, utensils, or other items needing protection.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
750.800e - Filters in hoods over ovens were soiled with buildup of grease and dust. Clean the hood filters.

Clean general surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed a display case, in front of the deli area, that had items at improper temperatures. Two separate types of chicken were probed, wings and 8-piece chicken with temperatures ranging from 47-53F. Ensure that the cooler is in proper working order, as well as not being over stacked to prevent the flow of air through it. The two items probed were destroyed and the managers placed a work order in for the cooler to be evaluated. 
750-250  All potentially hazardous foods shall be kept at 41°F or below while on display and service.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: 750-130(b) Observed a box of pretzel crisps stored on the floor in the walk in cooler. All food shall be stored at least six inches above the floor. Cease to store food on the floor. Box was moved to correct the violation.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: 750-880 Observed single service containers stored with the food contact surfaces exposed with no protection behind the refrigerated deli case. Single service shall be protected at all times during storage. Store single service containers inverted to protect the food contact surface or store under a cover. Food contact surfaces shall be protected at all times from potential contamination.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750-1210 Observed the prep sink by the sushi station to be separating from the wall. All fixtures attached the wall shall be sealed/caulked to provide a smooth and easily cleanable surface. Re-seal/re-caulk sink to the wall to provide a smooth and easily cleanable surface.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.comment:
750.530f - Employee doing food prep in fryer area was observed to be wearing a watch. Employee removed his watch prior to changing gloves and continuing with food prep.

Food employees shall not wear jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food, except for a plain ring such as a wedding band or medical information jewelry.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.citation_text:
750.1060 - Puddling water was observed on the floor in front of the 3 part sink. Manager noted the water line connected to the wall mounted chemical dispenser has a leak, and a work order was submitted for the issue.

All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.citation_text:
750.530 - Employee in deli area was observed chewing gum. Manager had employee discard gum in the trash.

Employees shall consume food only in designated dining areas, including gum and candy. An employee dining area shall not be so designated if consuming food there may result in contamination of other food, equipment, utensils, or other items needing protection.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text:
750.690 - A) (R) Two handles on the deli salad case were showing signs of disrepair (far left case next to hot case). One handle was starting to crack. The other handle was cracked and pulling apart. Repair or replace the handles of the deli salad case doors. If repairs are made (i.e. caulk, etc.), the end result must be smooth and easily cleanable.

B) Signage inside one of the deli case doors was observed to be soiled. Also, buildup was observed around a manufacturer's sticker on the outer surface of one deli case door. It was suggested to laminate signage that is to be posted inside cases. Also, clean around the door seals, edges of doors, and tracks as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
1120 - Soap was not available at the handsink adjacent to 3 part sink, and paper towels were not dispensing (end of the roll) at the handsink adjacent to deli cases up front. Soap and paper towels were replaced during the inspection.

A supply of soap and sanitary towels shall be provided at each lavatory. Maintain supplies of soap and paper towels at handsinks to allow for proper handwashing.

findings.title: Hot food at proper temperatures
findings.citation_text:
750.250 - Mashed potatoes and gravy in the hot case had surface temperatures at 120F/below. Internal temperatures for potatoes and gravy were observed at 126F and 118F respectively. Items were pulled from the hot case and discarded.
A service call will be placed for the hot case. The far left end appeared to be the only section of the unit not able to maintain foods at 135F/above (see general comments).

Hot potentially hazardous foods shall be kept at 135F/above  while on display and service.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text:
750.690 - A) Sprayer head at 3 part sink was pulling apart along the top outer seam, and moldy/grimy buildup was observed where disrepair was noted. Also the crevice around the sprayer surface had grimy buildup, which management noted was difficult to clean. Replace the sprayer head at the 3 part sink.

B) Two handles on the deli salad case were showing signs of disrepair. The handle of the door in front of the Tahitian salad was starting to crack. The handle of the door in front of the ham salad was cracked and pulling apart. Repair or replace the handles of the deli salad case doors.
 
Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e Observed the glass sliding doors of the deli display coolers to have slight mold accumulation along the tracks and along signage posted on the glass. Clean the tracks and remove and replace soiled signage as necessary to maintain clean. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 750-1200 There is a small section of coving pulled away from the wall to the right of the walk-in freezer. Replace coving so the barrier is sealed tightly against the wall. The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed that the floors under the shelving units in the front counter area have some dust under them.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean.
Clean the floors.
